name: method-conditional
note: An example of the variant-file shape: a method edit (every place the method names is written only when the person gave its content). `methodReplace` applies to every case whose method contains the text and must match at least one.
methodReplace: 每条先写结论，再写依据。
每条先写结论；用户给了依据才写依据，没给就只写结论。
